adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is normalized to lowercase (`map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter checks `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` using the raw `guest` string (no `.toLowerCase()`), so case-variant inputs can bypass the blacklist. Similarly, duplicate prevention uses `guest === attendee.email` against stored attendee emails without any normalization, allowing case-variant duplicates (e.g., `Bob@x.com` vs `bob@x.com`). The diff shows no lowercasing/normalization before comparisons or storage.
